layers.basics: The oscilloscope plots voltage against time, showing waveform shape, amplitude and frequency.
layers.deeper: Key controls: timebase, volts/div, trigger. Use a 10× probe with proper compensation.
layers.expert: Bandwidth ≥5× signal; rise time t_r=0.35/BW; sample rate vs memory depth; probe loading C≈10 pF; ground lead inductance causes ringing.

layers.basics: A multimeter measures voltage, current and resistance; always connect it correctly (current meters in series, voltmeters in parallel).
layers.deeper: Meters have finite input resistance (10 MΩ) that can load high-impedance circuits.
layers.expert: True-RMS vs average-responding; CAT safety ratings; accuracy in % of reading + digits; four-wire resistance measurements.

layers.basics: Produces sine, square, triangle and pulse signals at set frequency and amplitude.
layers.deeper: Output impedance is usually 50 Ω, which affects the load voltage unless matched.
layers.expert: Direct digital synthesis, phase accumulator, frequency resolution f_clk/2ᴺ; arbitrary waveforms.

layers.basics: A bench supply gives adjustable voltage with a current limit to protect circuits.
layers.deeper: Set the current limit before connecting; constant-voltage vs constant-current modes.
layers.expert: Linear vs switching; remote sense; programmable supplies; ripple and load regulation specs.

title: Logic analyzer
summary: See many digital lines at once.

layers.basics: Captures dozens of digital channels and shows timing diagrams; decodes buses such as I²C and SPI.
layers.deeper: Trigger on patterns; sample rate must exceed the fastest edges.
layers.expert: State vs timing mode; setup/hold checks; threshold selection; protocol decoders.

layers.basics: Shows signal strength vs frequency, revealing carriers, harmonics and noise.
layers.deeper: Resolution bandwidth sets frequency detail and noise floor; swept or FFT-based.
layers.expert: Dynamic range, displayed average noise level, phase noise; VNAs measure S-parameters with a source and receivers.

layers.basics: A solderless breadboard connects parts through spring contacts in rows; wires link them.
layers.deeper: Good for low-frequency prototypes; avoid for high-speed or RF because of stray capacitance.
layers.expert: Contact resistance, ~2–10 pF between rows, power rail splits; ground discipline; modular dev boards.

layers.basics: A hot iron melts solder that wets the pad and lead, forming a metal bond.
layers.deeper: Heat both pad and lead; use flux; shiny, concave joint is good. Wear eye protection and ventilate.
layers.expert: Leaded (Sn63/Pb37 183 °C) vs lead-free SAC305 (217 °C); reflow profiles, tombstoning, cold joints; ESD-safe handling.

layers.basics: Check power first, then signals stage by stage; compare against expectations; change one thing at a time.
layers.deeper: Divide and conquer; look at the simplest causes first; document each test.
layers.expert: Half-split method; injecting known signals; thermal imaging; comparing with a known-good board.

title: PCB design: schematic capture, layout, manufacturing files

layers.basics: Draw the schematic in a tool like KiCad, assign footprints, place parts, route traces, and export Gerber files for the manufacturer.
layers.deeper: Design rules (trace width, spacing), ground planes, decoupling close to ICs, controlled impedance for fast signals.
layers.expert: Stack-up design; return-path continuity; differential pairs; DFM/DFA; IPC-2221 current capacity; ERC/DRC checks.

layers.basics: A good lab report states purpose, method, data, analysis and conclusion so others can reproduce it.
layers.deeper: Plot data with error bars; compare measurement with theory and explain differences.
layers.expert: Uncertainty budgets per GUM; propagation; fitting with confidence intervals; reproducibility.

layers.basics: Every instrument has accuracy limits; repeated readings reveal random scatter, calibration reveals bias.
layers.deeper: Quote results with uncertainty; combine independent errors in quadrature.
layers.expert: Type A vs type B uncertainty; u_c=√Σ(∂f/∂xᵢ uᵢ)²; resolution vs accuracy; traceability to SI.

layers.basics: Mains voltage can kill; currents of ~10 mA through the body cause muscle lock and ~100 mA can stop the heart.
layers.deeper: Use isolated supplies, GFCI protection, one hand rule for high voltage, and discharge capacitors before touching.
layers.expert: Body resistance 1 kΩ–100 kΩ depending on skin; arc-flash energy; lockout–tagout; lithium battery hazards; laser safety classes.
